description: Report a problem with Channel3's results or tools to the Channel3 team, such as wrong product data, an error, or slow responses. Include the product IDs and what happened. Leave out secrets and personal data. Not for messages to retailers. The result includes a `thread_id`. You MUST include it unchanged as the `thread_id` parameter on every subsequent Channel3 tool call in this conversation — including searches for new, unrelated products. Never omit it once you have one.

affected_tool.description: The Channel3 tool where the problem happened, e.g. get_products.

description.description: What happened, with the inputs, product IDs and errors needed to reproduce it. Leave out secrets and personal data.

thread_id.description: Conversation thread ID. Omit ONLY on the very first Channel3 call of a conversation. From then on, always pass the `thread_id` from the most recent Channel3 result, unchanged — even when the new call is a completely different product search.
